name: TripSettlementCalculator
tagline: Driver trip pay, audited and approved into weekly pay sheets – in one Power Platform component.
description: Complete driver settlement app for trucking fleets: prices every trip from loaded and empty miles or the owner-operator share of linehaul plus fuel surcharge, adds stop pay, detention, layover and hazmat, subtracts advances and deductions, audits POD, duplicates, overlaps, miles and deductions, and moves trips through submit → audit → approve → pay with approval limits, holds and weekly pay sheets.
features: Mileage, percentage (owner-operator), team and minimum trip pay
Stop pay, detention after free hours, layover, hazmat, other pay
Advances, fuel and other deductions with a max-deduction rule
12 audit checks incl. missing POD, duplicate load, overlapping trips, miles over plan
Draft → Submitted → Audited → Approved → Paid, On hold, send back
Approval limit per role, audit notes, undo
Weekly driver pay sheets with one-click approval and mark paid
Payroll CSV, trip CSV, pay sheet text, SummaryJson
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
